title: Ebola in East Africa
summary: A Bundibugyo-strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with no approved vaccine or treatment, has passed 9,400 cases and 4,500 deaths across eight provinces; North Kivu has barred entry from Ituri. Kenya has eight cases, all linked to one imported patient.

background.text: Outbreak detected in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
Kenya's first patient, who travelled from Congo, dies in Nairobi.
